_comment: Static target registry. Parsed by endpoint/targets.py into the model-free types in
contract.py. Loading this file NEVER imports an endpoint module and NEVER loads model
weights. Revisions here are real, resolved 40-hex commits -- see
docs/stage3/MODEL_IDENTITY.md for how each was obtained. A branch name, short SHA or
placeholder is rejected at load time.
Created once by the Stage 3 foundation task; ownership transfers to Rayyan (endpoint/).

emotion_distilroberta.notes: Existing pinned model, unchanged. Revision verified against the local Hugging Face cache (refs/main). The V6 benchmark run itself predates this pin; see artifacts/benchmark_v6/PROVENANCE.md.

sentiment_distilbert_sst2.notes: Labels are UPPERCASE and must never be lowercased or mapped onto emotion labels. max_sequence_length is the tokenizer's model_max_length, not a model-card training length. Weight loading and served label space are Task 2's runtime acceptance requirement.

emotion_7.description: Seven-label English emotion classification. The original experiment.

sentiment_2.description: Two-label English sentiment classification (SST-2). Baseline file is produced by Task 4 and does not exist yet; its absence is checked when a sentiment evaluation is executed, not at registry load.

emotion_v2.description: Original hardened emotion endpoint with the four frozen defenses. Unchanged.

sentiment_v1.description: V1-equivalent sentiment wrapper. There is deliberately no sentiment V2. version is v1 for legacy compatibility; target_id is what distinguishes it from emotion_v1. Module is created by Task 2 and does not exist yet.

emotion.core.description: The original V1/V2 emotion experiment. Uses the task baseline_file.

emotion.oces.description: Additional evaluation against the same two emotion targets. Seed file overrides the task baseline; the hash recorded for a run must be of THIS file, not of baseline/baseline.json.

sentiment.core.description: Single-target sentiment core run. Analysis emits comparison:null. The generated attack count is whatever the builders produce for this task; it is not required to equal the emotion suite's 1928.

ci.emotion.description: The release gate. emotion_v2 as candidate against a frozen selection of the core suite. suite_id stays 'core' deliberately: CI is a selection, not a third suite. The approved clean-output reference replaces a second live V1 service.
